DO NOT CONNECT SPEAKER OUTPUT TO GND
Speaker goes only to OUT + / OUT -
3V3 sensors/MPU come from the ESP32 3V3 pin.
Amp VIN comes from the 5 V rail (boost) - see Diagram 9.
Every module GND joins one common GND.
GPIO numbers are the source-PDF reference map (Figures 5, 8, 12).
Verify labels on your actual modules before permanent wiring.
GPIO21/22 = default I2C. ADC1 pins keep working with Wi-Fi/BT on.
